headline: Brainbees Solutions Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Brainbees Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about the extension in the timeline for remittance of the initial subscription amount in Swara Corp., USA, a wholly owned subsidiary of Swara Baby Products Limited,…
detail: Acquisition - Brainbees Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about the extension in the timeline for remittance of the initial subscription amount in Swara Corp., USA, a wholly owned subsidiary of Swara Baby Products Limited, Subsidiary of the Company.
